serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: The Specset Cloud Platform is an AI platform for construction document review. It automates technical review across project manuals, drawing sheets and shop drawings: submittal review against project specifications, UFGS (Unified Facilities Guide Specifications) compliance checking, design review automation, asset management logic, and search and question answering across a project's documents. The platform flags potential issues and returns cited answers drawn from the customer's own project documents.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Specset Trust Center. The landing page, compliance posture summary, subprocessor list and FedRAMP milestone information are public. FedRAMP Certification Data (Security Decision Record, example Ongoing Certification Report, information-resources inventory, SOC 2 Type II report and engagement letter, the incident-response and vulnerability-management procedures, and twelve individual supporting-evidence documents covering change management, network boundary and egress, identity and staff authentication, training effectiveness, incident response records, encryption, vulnerability detection, inventory sources, assessment materials and recovery configuration) is published as restricted resources.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: The landing page at https://trust.specset.com requires no login. FedRAMP staff and agency reviewers request access to the restricted FedRAMP Certification Data from the Trust Center page. Specset approves requests manually and does not require acceptance of terms or a non-disclosure agreement. If a request is not approved within one business day, email fedramp@specset.com. Everything FedRAMP CDS-CSO-PUB requires is published without authentication at https://specset.com/fedramp/ and https://specset.com/fedramp/fedramp.json.

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: Source repository for this public FedRAMP information (fedramp.json and the generated human-readable page) with full change history.

FedRAMP Certification Data for the Specset Cloud Platform: Security Decision Record, example Ongoing Certification Report, information-resources inventory with its generator and sources, SOC 2 Type II report with management representation letter and engagement letters, the incident-response and vulnerability-management procedures, twelve individual supporting-evidence documents (change management record, network boundary and egress verification, identity and staff authentication verification, training effectiveness review, incident response records, encryption and secrets configuration, vulnerability detection baseline, inventory sources, assessment materials and schedule, recovery and backup configuration), and the security policies maintained in Vanta.
additionalRepositories.accessRequestInstructions: Request access from the Trust Center page. Specset approves requests from FedRAMP staff and agency reviewers manually, without terms or a non-disclosure agreement. If a request is not approved within one business day, email fedramp@specset.com.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: The Specset Cloud Platform is a single multi-tenant SaaS service for construction document intelligence. It ingests customer project documents (project manuals and specifications, drawing sheets, shop drawings and submittals) and provides automated submittal review against project specifications, UFGS and specification compliance checking, design review automation, document search and question answering across a project's documents, and asset management logic. Customers use the service through a web application. Optional customer-initiated integrations connect to the customer's own Procore or Autodesk tenants. Production runs on Google Cloud Platform in project specset-prod-assured (Assured Workloads, FEDRAMP_MODERATE control package, us-west1), with supporting services on Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure as listed under third-party information resources. A per-organization CUI mode restricts model, embedding and web-grounding calls to the Assured Workloads project (Vertex AI, location us), disables the commercial AI and support-chat integrations, and never calls Perplexity. Federal tenants are provisioned with CUI mode enabled.

certified.useCase: Google Cloud Platform (Google Services) — primary hosting of all production infrastructure in project specset-prod-assured (Assured Workloads): GKE Autopilot, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Memorystore, Cloud KMS, Cloud Load Balancing and Cloud Armor, Cloud Logging and Monitoring, Secret Manager, Artifact Registry, and Vertex AI (Gemini) model inference, embeddings and Web Grounding for Enterprise. Organizations in CUI mode use Vertex AI in the Assured Workloads project at location us only; other organizations use Vertex AI in a peer Google Cloud project outside Assured Workloads. Stores and processes customer data.

AWS US East/West — supporting services: Amazon SES (transactional email), Route 53 (DNS), S3 (CI build cache, CloudTrail audit logs, and a legacy database-backup bucket from the pre-2026 hosting platform), GuardDuty (threat detection), and Amazon Bedrock (Claude model inference in us-west-2, for organizations not in CUI mode; prompts may include customer document text).

Azure Commercial Cloud — Azure OpenAI (GPT model inference for organizations not in CUI mode; prompts may include customer document text) and Microsoft Entra ID application registrations for customer 'Sign in with Microsoft' single sign-on. No customer data is stored on Azure.

Google Workspace — provider identity (Cloud Identity) for staff access to production through Identity-Aware Proxy, with security-key or passkey 2-Step Verification enforced for all staff; staff email including the FedRAMP Security Inbox. No customer data.

GitHub Enterprise Cloud — source control and CI/CD for the application and infrastructure-as-code. Dependabot security alerts and CodeQL code scanning run on the application and infrastructure repositories, with Dependabot version updates on the infrastructure repository. Deploys to production through OpenID Connect workload identity federation. No customer data.

Vanta Trust Management Platform — continuous configuration monitoring of the production cloud accounts (read-only metadata), compliance evidence and policies, and the Specset Trust Center at trust.specset.com. No customer data.
Slack — operational alerting and change-notification channel for the provider (infrastructure change notifications, security alerts). Resource metadata only; no customer data.

Perplexity Enterprise and API Platform (FedRAMP Certified, Class B) — web search for AI features of organizations not in CUI mode. Receives model-generated search queries; customer documents are not sent. Never called for organizations in CUI mode: their web lookups run on Vertex AI Web Grounding for Enterprise inside the Google Cloud Assured Workloads project.

nonCertified.name: Anthropic API (Claude)
nonCertified.useCase: Direct Claude model inference for a small set of models not served through Amazon Bedrock, selectable only by Specset administrators; prompts may include customer document text. Never enabled for organizations in CUI mode.

nonCertified.name: Intercom
nonCertified.useCase: In-app customer support chat for organizations not in CUI mode. Processes customer user contact details and support conversation content; no project documents. The messenger never loads for an organization in CUI mode and its memberships are never shared with Intercom.

nonCertified.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini API)
nonCertified.useCase: Gemini API path outside the Google Cloud FedRAMP boundary, used as the embedding provider for organizations not in CUI mode; prompts may include customer document text. Never used for organizations in CUI mode, whose embeddings run on Vertex AI in the Assured Workloads project. Retirement is planned before the Class C application.

nonCertified.name: Cloudflare
nonCertified.useCase: Two uses. Edge fronting for the Trust Center custom hostname (trust.specset.com) as provided by Vanta; no customer data. Cloudflare AI Gateway and Workers AI for experimental open-model inference selectable by organizations not in CUI mode; prompts may include customer document text, and inference runs in Cloudflare data centers worldwide. The gateway does not store prompt or completion payloads, and the per-organization CUI mode excludes it. The Cloudflare for Government offering is not used.

nonCertified.name: Firecrawl
nonCertified.useCase: Public-web scraping of bid-portal and specification-research pages. Receives public URLs only; no customer data.

nonCertified.name: NOAA / National Weather Service APIs
nonCertified.provider: US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (federal agency)
nonCertified.useCase: Public weather and tide data for project daily logs. Receives a project site's latitude and longitude only; forecasts and tide data are returned to the daily log. Nothing is stored at the service. A US federal government data service, not a cloud service offering.

nonCertified.name: Better Stack
nonCertified.useCase: External uptime monitoring, on-call scheduling and the public status page (status.specset.com). Availability metadata and provider on-call contacts only; no customer data.

nonCertified.name: Replit (specset.com marketing site hosting)
nonCertified.useCase: Hosts the public marketing site at specset.com, including the public FedRAMP information at specset.com/fedramp/. Outside the offering; serves public content and prospect inquiry forms only. No customer data.

nonCertified.name: Apryse (PDFTron) SDK
nonCertified.useCase: Document rendering SDK that executes in the customer's browser; only license-validation pings leave the environment. No customer data.

nonCertified.name: CARTO basemaps
nonCertified.useCase: Browser-loaded map tiles for the facility map view. CARTO receives the user's IP address and the requested tile coordinates, which indicate the approximate facility location; no server-side data.

nonCertified.name: Google Fonts
nonCertified.useCase: Web fonts loaded by the user's browser on each application page. Google receives the browser's IP address and user agent; no customer content.

nonCertified.name: Autodesk Platform Services
nonCertified.useCase: Optional customer-initiated integration to the customer's own Autodesk tenant through OAuth; the customer chooses and authorizes the data exchanged. Not used unless a customer connects it.

nonCertified.name: Procore
nonCertified.useCase: Optional customer-initiated integration to the customer's own Procore tenant through OAuth; the customer chooses and authorizes the data exchanged. Not used unless a customer connects it.

nonCertified.name: Claude Code
nonCertified.useCase: Coding assistant used by the founders on operator laptops, outside the offering. It reads production configuration, cluster state, metadata and application logs as a dedicated read-only service account and, with a founder's approval each time, database rows through a read-only, time-limited tunnel; what it reads is sent to the model provider. It has no write access to production and never runs inside the boundary. Gap: rows of organizations in CUI mode are not yet excluded from that read-only database role. Plan: enforce the exclusion with row-level security before 2026-12-01.

nonCertified.name: OpenAI Codex
nonCertified.useCase: Coding assistant used by the founders on operator laptops, outside the offering, under the same production-access protocol as Claude Code: reads as the dedicated read-only service account, founder-approved read-only database access, no write access to production. What it reads is sent to the model provider. The same planned exclusion of CUI-mode rows applies.
